Fry-Pagan (2011) median-target rotation

Source: R/id-extra.R
irf_fry_pagan.Rd

Among the accepted draws of a set-identified irf() (sign / zero-sign), picks the single draw whose IRFs are closest, in standardised squared distance over all responses, shocks and horizons, to the pointwise median. It returns one internally consistent structural model instead of the incoherent pointwise median.

Usage

irf_fry_pagan(x)

Arguments

x

a varm_irf object with draws (from sign-type identification).

Value

list with index (into x$draws[,,,index] and x$draw), irf ([K,K,H+1]), impact (K x K impact matrix) and varm_draw (index of the reduced-form draw it came from).

Details

Economic intuition. Report this alongside the set bands when you need one coherent shock series, historical decomposition or FEVD. Pitfall: the median-target is itself a function of the prior over rotations and is not "the" estimate.

See also

Other identification: id_hetero(), id_proxy(), id_restrictions(), id_zerosign(), identification, proxy_draws()

Examples

S <- matrix(c(1, 1, 1, 1, -1, 0, 1, 0, 0), 3, 3, byrow = TRUE)
r <- irf(draws(varm(yraw, p = 2), "mc", 30), id_sign(S), horizon = 4)
irf_fry_pagan(r)$index
#> [1] 18
